name: notification-hub-decision-page-writer
description: The shared decision-page writer (packages/api-core/decisionpage). One Codex Luna run makes one Notification Hub decision page from a sender's facts and evidence, following a brief in its job folder under ~/.vrooli/state/vrooli/decision-pages/. It reads the notification-hub skill, writes page.html, RETURN.md and shots/ in that folder, checks the page with `notification-hub pages check` and photographs it with headless Chrome. It sends nothing. No sandbox, because the job folder is outside the repository and Chrome needs the host.
